themes.name: Push notifications
themes.description: Reviews about push or news-alert notifications, including whether they can be turned off or customized, how frequent they are, and whether they clear after being tapped.

themes.name: Playlist and queue
themes.description: Reviews about building, saving, reordering, and managing the playlist or listening queue, including playlists that are lost or cleared after closing or updating the app.

themes.name: Story and podcast playback
themes.description: Reviews about on-demand story and podcast audio behavior, such as skipping, repeating, cutting off early, starting mid-story, jumping to the next item, or not resuming a position.

themes.name: Live stream and stations
themes.description: Reviews about streaming live radio and local stations, including connecting, buffering, dropped streams, missing stations, and 'unable to play this media' errors.

themes.name: Background activity and battery
themes.description: Reviews about the app running in the background, starting at boot or on its own, lacking a way to quit, and its battery, data, or memory use.

themes.name: Crashes and stability
themes.description: Reviews about the app crashing, force closing, freezing, failing to launch, or breaking after an update or on a particular device.

themes.name: Political bias and trust
themes.description: Reviews about NPR's perceived political slant, impartiality, honesty, and trustworthiness as a news source.

themes.name: Interface design and usability
themes.description: Reviews about how the app looks and is laid out, how easy it is to navigate, and whether the design feels dated or modern.

themes.name: Programming and content
themes.description: Reviews about the quality, variety, and availability of NPR's stories, shows, and podcasts offered in the app.
